offering_description.value: SS&C provides investment software and outsourced fund operations to asset managers, banks, insurers and other financial institutions. It also supplies health plan and pharmacy benefit technology, virtual data rooms, enterprise automation and resort management software. It delivers these offerings through cloud platforms and teams that handle work such as fund administration, investor servicing and claims processing.
